resize_tensor_by_size: resize a PyTorch tensor to a specified output size using nearest neighbor interpolation
resize_tensor_by_scale: resize a PyTorch tensor by a given scale factor using bilinear interpolation
resize_tensor_align_corners: resize a PyTorch tensor with align_corners enabled and alignment warning checks
resize_tensor_custom_mode: resize a PyTorch tensor using a custom interpolation mode such as bicubic or area
resize_tensor_suppress_warning: resize a PyTorch tensor with alignment warnings suppressed for clean output
